verdict.rationale: Firm documents a clear early-stage/venture financing practice and explicitly mentions 'convertible instruments' representation plus a Clerky partnership for formation/founder stock/83(b) docs, and extensive deal volume in venture financings. However, evidence lacks published explainers, forms, or specific SAFE-focused content (SAFEs are never named), and the Clerky partnership/convertible-instrument mentions are framed around investor-side/priced rounds rather than a dedicated pre-seed/seed SAFE practice description. Missing for 10: explicit mention of SAFEs, published SAFE/convertible note explainer content or forms, and founder-side pre-seed specific guidance.
